name: synthetic-provider-error
description: GrowSurf refuses the call: 403 with the flat error envelope every non-2xx carries, where `code` is the stable machine-readable half. Vendor non-2xx is DATA — the engine classifies it as a provider error and the run completes at zero usage. Serves every endpoint. Authored from the GrowSurf REST v2 (2.0.0) response shape, verified field for field against a live deployment on 2026-09-22; the identities are GrowSurf's own published example values.

body.name: NotAuthorizedError
body.message: No API key provided. Send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.
